cnTitle: 怎么谈加薪？先准备成绩和市场行情，再约时间
enTitle: How to Ask for a Raise: Prepare Results and Market Data, Then Ask
enDesc: Do not ask for a raise merely from feeling underpaid. First organize your achievements, contributions and measurable results, learn market salaries for the role and the company s review cycle, and request a formal meeting at a good time, giving a reasonable range and expressing long-term commitment. If it is not granted now, ask for the conditions and timeline, and consider other options if talks fail; lead with facts and data.
cnDesc: 谈加薪不要只凭"我觉得低"，先整理自己的业绩、贡献和可量化成果，了解同岗位市场薪资和公司调薪节奏，选合适时机正式约谈，给出合理区间并表达长期意愿；若暂时不加，问清条件和时间，谈不拢再考虑其他选择，沟通以事实和数据为主。

cnTitle: 工作中被冤枉、背锅怎么办？先冷静、用事实澄清
enTitle: What to Do When Wrongly Blamed: Stay Calm and Clarify With Facts
enDesc: When wrongly blamed, steady your emotions first and do not rush to argue or sulk; organize the timeline, emails and records, and clarify with the responsible person using facts and evidence to separate responsibility. For significant losses or accountability, give a formal written account and keep evidence, and raise it upward or to HR rather than silently accepting blame.
cnDesc: 被冤枉时先稳住情绪，不要急于争辩或赌气，把事情的经过、时间线、邮件和记录整理清楚，用事实和证据向相关负责人澄清，分清责任边界；涉及重大损失或责任追究，要正式书面说明并保留证据，必要时向上级或HR反映，避免默默认下。

cnTitle: 被领导打压、PUA怎么办？认清模式、守住自我价值
enTitle: How to Cope With a Manipulative Manager: Recognize It and Keep Your Self-Worth
enDesc: When you face persistent denial, false promises, demeaning or pressure, recognize it as unreasonable control and do not equate the manager s evaluation with your worth. Record work with facts and results, set boundaries and focus on the issue, raise it to HR or above when needed, and update your resume and prepare a fallback; take your health seriously when it is strongly affected.
cnDesc: 被持续否定、画饼、贬低或施压，要先认清这是不合理的控制方式，不把对方的评价等同于自我价值；用事实和成果记录工作，明确边界、就事论事，必要时向HR或更上级反映，同时更新简历、准备退路，严重影响身心时要重视自己的健康。

cnTitle: 35岁还没当管理怎么办？别用单一标准衡量自己
enTitle: What to Do if Not in Management by 35: Avoid One Standard
enDesc: Professional value is not equal to managing people; specialist depth, experience and being hard to replace matter too. First decide whether you want management or excel at a specialty; for management, build leadership and coordination and seek opportunities, and for a specialist path, deepen expertise and build influence, planning long term with health and family rather than being hijacked by age anxiety.
cnDesc: 职业价值不等于是否带团队，专业深度、行业经验和不可替代性同样重要；先想清楚自己是想做管理还是擅长专业，想做管理就补领导和协调能力、争取机会，走专业路线就深耕专长、建立影响力，结合健康和家庭做长期规划，不必被"35岁焦虑"绑架。

cnTitle: 副业转主业怎么看？先看稳定收入再决定
enTitle: Should You Turn a Side Hustle Full-Time: Stable Income First
enDesc: Before turning a side hustle full-time, see whether it can deliver stable income (ideally covering basic living for at least six months), growth and something you can replicate, and weigh social insurance, savings and risk. It is best to keep the main job and refine the side business until income, customers and cash flow are stable, rather than resigning impulsively at the first sign of success.
cnDesc: 副业转主业前，先看它能否持续带来稳定收入（一般建议至少覆盖基本生活半年以上）、是否有增长空间和可复制性，再算清社保、储备和风险；最好先保留主业、把副业跑顺，等收入稳定、有一定客户和现金流再全职，避免在副业刚有起色时冲动裸辞。

cnTitle: 通勤太远要不要换工作？算时间成本和实际方案
enTitle: Should You Change Jobs for a Long Commute: Time Cost and Options
enDesc: A very long commute consumes much time and energy; first quantify its time, health and family cost, and see whether adjusting the role, working from home, moving or changing transport can solve it. If none works and it long-term affects health, consider a job with a reasonable commute, weighing pay, growth and quality of life.
cnDesc: 超长通勤每天消耗大量时间精力，先量化它占用的时间、健康和家庭成本，再看能否通过调整岗位、居家办公、搬家或换交通方式解决；若都不可行、且长期影响身心，再考虑换一份通勤合理的工作，决定时综合比较收入、发展和生活质量。

cnTitle: 同事总把活推给你怎么办？分清楚、设边界
enTitle: What to Do When a Coworker Dumps Work: Clarify and Set Boundaries
enDesc: When work is pushed to you, separate normal collaboration and temporary help from laziness or unclear ownership. Do your own tasks, and politely but clearly decline or return what is not yours, asking the manager to clarify division when needed; use priorities and workload rather than taking everything for fear of offending.
cnDesc: 被推活先分清是正常协作、临时帮忙，还是对方偷懒、责任不清；属于自己的活做好，不该你做的礼貌而明确地拒绝或推回，必要时请领导明确分工，用工作安排和优先级说话，不因为怕得罪人而一直承担，最后反而自己受累。

cnTitle: 职场要不要站队？先看性质，尽量靠专业立身
enTitle: Should You Take Sides at Work: Read the Situation and Rely on Professionalism
enDesc: When facing office factions, separate normal collaboration from interest-based cliques. Avoid unprincipled side-taking and establish yourself through professionalism, results and good collaboration, focusing on the issue rather than people. If you must take a position, base it on work and company interests, do not gossip or lightly offend, and keep your independence.
cnDesc: 面对办公室派系，先分清是正常的工作配合还是利益小圈子；尽量不卷入无原则的站队，用专业能力、业绩和良好协作立身，对事不对人；若必须表态，以工作和公司利益为依据，不背后议论、不轻易得罪人，保持自己的独立性。

cnTitle: 复合后又分手、反复怎么办？看核心问题有没有解决
enTitle: What to Do About On-Off Cycles: Whether the Core Problem Was Solved
enDesc: Breaking up again after reuniting usually means the core problem that caused the split was never truly solved. Calmly review the recurring conflict and whether both sides are willing to change, rather than relying on nostalgia; if the problem cannot be solved and the cycle keeps draining you, seriously consider letting go and save energy for a relationship that can move forward steadily.
cnDesc: 复合后再分开，往往是当初导致分手的核心问题并没有真正解决；冷静复盘反复出现的矛盾是什么、双方是否都愿意改变，而不是只靠不舍和回忆；若问题无法解决、反复消耗，就要认真考虑放下，把精力留给能稳定向前的关系。

cnTitle: 异地恋坚持不下去怎么办？先看共同计划和沟通
enTitle: What to Do When Long Distance Is Hard: Shared Plans and Communication
enDesc: Long-distance relationships often tire from distance, communication and security. First see whether there is a clear timeline and plan to end the distance and come together, then improve communication, set regular contact and build trust. If there is long-term no result and one side will not work toward the future, seriously consider whether to continue rather than waiting without an end.
cnDesc: 异地恋容易因距离、沟通和安全感而疲惫，先看两人有没有明确的结束异地、走到一起的时间表和共同计划，再改善沟通质量、固定联系、建立信任；若长期看不到结果、一方不愿为未来努力，就要认真考虑是否继续，别在没有终点的等待里消耗。

cnTitle: 相亲对象条件好但没感觉怎么办？分清条件和相处
enTitle: What to Do When a Blind Date Is Good on Paper but There Is No Spark: Conditions and Rapport
enDesc: When conditions are suitable but there is no spark, consider whether feeling can grow or whether there truly is no common language and comfort. Meet a few more times to see the person s character and whether you are comfortable; do not force it for external conditions or dismiss it for a lack of instant attraction, since marriage needs both a realistic foundation and emotional fit.
cnDesc: 条件合适但没感觉，先想清楚"感觉"是慢慢培养的，还是确实没有共同语言、相处不舒服；可以多接触几次、看人品和相处是否舒服，不必因外在条件勉强，也不必因一时没有心动就否定，婚姻要兼顾现实基础和情感契合。

cnTitle: 婚前发现对方隐瞒债务怎么办？先核实、再谈坦诚
enTitle: What to Do if Your Partner Hid Debt: Verify and Discuss Honesty
enDesc: If you find your partner hid debt before marriage, calmly verify the amount and nature (such as gambling or high-interest loans) and whether it could involve you, then communicate honestly and see whether the person is willing to disclose fully and handle it together. Marriage also involves financial trust; take significant concealment or bad debt seriously, consult a lawyer when needed and consider a prenuptial agreement.
cnDesc: 婚前发现对方隐瞒债务，先冷静核实债务的金额、性质（如赌债、高利贷风险）和是否牵连自己，再坦诚沟通，看对方是否愿意如实说明、共同处理；婚姻也涉及财务信任，重大隐瞒或不良债务要慎重，必要时咨询专业律师，做婚前财产约定。

cnTitle: 恐婚怎么办？先找清楚害怕的是什么
enTitle: What to Do About Fear of Marriage: Find What You Fear
enDesc: Fear of marriage may come from worry over commitment, freedom or responsibility, or from family and past experiences. First identify concretely what you fear, separate what can be discussed and prepared from unresolved past issues, communicate honestly with your partner and plan together, and seek professional help when needed; do not force it under social pressure.
cnDesc: 恐婚可能来自对承诺、失去自由、责任压力的担忧，或原生家庭、过往经历的影响；先具体找出自己害怕的是什么，分清哪些是可以沟通和准备的，哪些是没处理好的过往，和伴侣坦诚交流、共同规划，必要时寻求专业帮助，不必因社会催促而勉强。

cnTitle: 恋爱脑、过度付出怎么办？先把自己的生活找回来
enTitle: What to Do About Over-Investing: Reclaim Your Own Life
enDesc: Over-investing and placing all attention on the partner tends to lose yourself and unbalance the relationship. Rebuild your work, friends, interests and growth, keep independence and boundaries, and learn to love yourself as well as be loved; a healthy relationship is two independent people drawn to each other, not one person clinging.
cnDesc: 过度付出、把全部注意力放在对方身上，往往会失去自我、也让关系失衡；先把自己的工作、朋友、兴趣和成长重新经营起来，保持独立和边界，学会被爱也要爱自己，健康的关系是两个独立的人互相吸引，而不是一方依附。

cnTitle: 婚后没朋友、失去自我怎么办？给自己留空间
enTitle: What to Do When You Lose Yourself After Marriage: Keep Your Own Space
enDesc: If after marriage you give all your time to the family and give up your social life and hobbies, you can lose yourself and accumulate resentment. Keep your own space, friends and interests, agree with your partner on personal and shared time, and keep growing and independent; marriage is two people walking together, not one person disappearing into the family.
cnDesc: 婚后若把全部时间给家庭、放弃自己的社交和爱好，容易失去自我、积累委屈；要主动保留个人空间、朋友联系和兴趣，和伴侣约定各自的时间和共同的时间，保持成长和独立，婚姻是两人同行，而不是一个人消失在家庭里。

cnTitle: 配偶出轨后怎么办？先稳住自己，再做决定
enTitle: How to Handle a Partner s Infidelity: Steady Yourself, Then Decide
enDesc: After discovering infidelity, first care for your emotions and body and do not rush to decide or retaliate. Understand the facts and clarify what you want (repair or leave); for repair, see whether the partner sincerely admits it, ends contact completely and works at it. If you choose to leave, attend to property, evidence and children, and seek a lawyer and counselor when needed.
cnDesc: 发现配偶出轨，先照顾好自己的情绪和身体，不急于当场做决定或报复；了解事实、想清楚自己要什么（修复还是离开），若选择修复，要看对方是否真诚认错、彻底断联并共同努力；若选择离开，注意财产、证据和子女安排，必要时找专业律师和咨询师。

cnTitle: 脂肪肝怎么调理？管嘴、迈开腿、控体重
enTitle: How to Manage a Fatty Liver: Diet, Exercise and Weight Control
enDesc: Fatty liver is often linked to excess weight, diet and inactivity, and early cases often improve with weight control, less greasy and sweet food and alcohol, and regular aerobic exercise. Recheck liver function and ultrasound, do not trust liver-protecting supplements, and seek a gastroenterology or liver clinic for abnormal blood sugar or lipids or worsening; follow the doctor.
cnDesc: 脂肪肝多与超重、饮食和缺乏运动有关，早期通过控制体重、减少油腻甜食和酒精、规律有氧运动多可改善；定期复查肝功能和B超，不要轻信"护肝"保健品，合并血糖血脂异常或加重时到消化科或肝病科就诊，以医生评估为准。

cnTitle: 焦虑心慌、检查没大事怎么办？先排除身体，再调情绪
enTitle: What to Do About Anxiety and Palpitations: Rule Out the Body, Then Manage the Mind
enDesc: For palpitations, chest tightness and nervousness, first get an ECG and other checks at a proper hospital to rule out heart problems. If tests are normal but symptoms recur, it may relate to anxiety, stress and the autonomic nervous system, and can improve with regular sleep, exercise, relaxation and professional psychological or psychiatric help when needed; do not scare yourself or ignore real bodily signals.
cnDesc: 心慌、胸闷、紧张等不适，先到正规医院做心电图等检查排除心脏等问题；若检查无明显异常但症状反复，可能与焦虑、压力和植物神经有关，可通过规律作息、运动、放松和必要时的心理或精神科专业帮助改善，不要自己吓自己，也不要忽视真正的身体信号。

cnTitle: 胃肠不好怎么调理？规律饮食、细嚼慢咽、查病因
enTitle: How to Manage Digestive Trouble: Regular Meals, Slow Eating and Finding the Cause
enDesc: Digestive trouble often relates to irregular meals, irritants, stress and H. pylori. Eat regular, plain and slowly, and reduce late nights and emotional stress; for recurring pain, acid reflux, black stools or weight loss, get an endoscopy and other checks in time rather than relying on painkillers, and follow the doctor s diagnosis.
cnDesc: 胃肠问题多与饮食不规律、刺激、压力和幽门螺杆菌有关，先定时定量、清淡饮食、细嚼慢咽，减少熬夜和情绪刺激；反复胃痛、反酸、黑便或消瘦要及时做胃镜等检查，不要长期靠止痛药或胃药硬扛，以医生诊断为准。

cnTitle: 家人突然晕倒怎么办？先判断、呼救、正确处置
enTitle: What to Do When a Family Member Faints: Assess, Call for Help and Act
enDesc: If someone faints, gently shake and call to check consciousness and breathing, and dial 120 immediately. If there is no breathing or only gasping, start CPR and ask someone to get an AED; if breathing but unconscious, place them on their side, keep the airway clear, and do not move them or give water. Protect the neck if injury is suspected, and keep watching while waiting for help.
cnDesc: 发现有人晕倒，先轻拍呼喊判断意识和呼吸，立即拨打120；无呼吸或不正常（如仅有叹息样呼吸）要立即进行心肺复苏并请人取AED，有呼吸但意识不清则侧卧、保持气道通畅、不随意搬动或喂水，怀疑外伤注意保护颈椎，等待急救时持续观察。

cnTitle: 孩子发育过早、性早熟怎么办？先到正规医院评估
enTitle: What to Do About Early Puberty: Get a Proper Assessment
enDesc: If a child develops secondary sexual characteristics early or has a sudden growth spurt, get a pediatric or endocrinology assessment of bone age and development, separating simple early puberty from disease. Avoid hormone-containing supplements, control weight and screen exposure, and follow the doctor; do not buy height or hormone products yourself.
cnDesc: 发现孩子过早出现第二性征、身高突然加速，要到正规医院儿科或内分泌科评估骨龄和发育情况，分清是单纯性早熟还是疾病引起；少给孩子吃含激素的补品、控制体重和电子产品接触，治疗以医生评估为准，不要自行买增高或激素类产品。

cnTitle: 老人跌倒怎么办？先别急着扶，看情况
enTitle: What to Do When an Older Adult Falls: Do Not Rush to Lift
enDesc: Do not rush to lift an older adult after a fall; first ask and check consciousness, pain, fractures and head injury. If a fracture or head injury is suspected, keep them still and call 120; if fine, lift slowly, then seek medical checks. During recovery, exercise under guidance, prevent another fall, and attend to osteoporosis and non-slip home safety.
cnDesc: 老人跌倒后不要急于扶起，先询问、检查意识和有无疼痛、骨折或头部外伤，怀疑骨折或头部受伤要保持其姿势、拨打120；确认无大碍再缓慢扶起，之后就医检查，康复期在医生指导下锻炼、防再次跌倒，重视骨质疏松和居家防滑。

cnTitle: 痛风、尿酸高怎么办？管住饮食、规范治疗
enTitle: How to Manage Gout and High Uric Acid: Diet and Proper Treatment
enDesc: For gout and high uric acid, reduce high-purine foods (organ meats, seafood, rich broths), limit sugary drinks and alcohol, drink more water and control weight. Rest and elevate the limb during an acute attack and seek care; whether to take long-term uric-acid medicine is decided by the doctor based on levels and attacks, and you should not stop medicine or use folk remedies yourself.
cnDesc: 痛风和高尿酸要减少高嘌呤食物（动物内脏、海鲜、浓肉汤）、少喝含糖饮料和酒、多喝水，控制体重；急性发作时休息、抬高患肢并就医，是否长期降尿酸由医生根据尿酸和发作情况决定，不要自行停药或乱用偏方。

cnTitle: 感冒发烧要不要输液、吃抗生素？多数感冒是病毒
enTitle: Do You Need an IV or Antibiotics for a Cold: Most Colds Are Viral
enDesc: The common cold is mostly viral, and antibiotics do not work on viruses; do not demand an IV or antibiotics just to recover faster. Use rest, fluids and symptomatic care, and watch for high fever that does not break, breathing trouble, poor condition or underlying disease; seek care promptly, and let the doctor decide on medicine.
cnDesc: 普通感冒多由病毒引起，抗生素对病毒无效，不要为了"好得快"就要求输液或吃抗生素；以休息、多喝水、对症处理为主，注意观察，高烧不退、呼吸困难、精神差或有基础病要及时就医，是否用药由医生判断，以正规治疗为准。

cnTitle: 孩子沉迷手机游戏怎么办？先找原因、定规则、做榜样
enTitle: What to Do About Phone Addiction: Find the Cause, Set Rules and Be a Model
enDesc: Phone addiction often comes from boredom, lack of company, stress or escape. Increase parent-child time and real activities, agree on time, content and rules with the child, and set an example by reducing your own phone use. Guide rather than simply confiscating, watch the impact on learning and emotions, and persist gently when needed.
cnDesc: 孩子沉迷手机往往是因为无聊、缺陪伴、压力或逃避；先增加亲子陪伴和现实活动，再和孩子一起约定使用时间、内容和规则，家长自己也要减少刷手机做榜样；用疏导而非简单没收，关注是否影响学习和情绪，必要时温和坚持。

cnTitle: 孩子被校园霸凌怎么办？先接纳、再介入、保护安全
enTitle: What to Do About Bullying: Accept, Intervene and Protect
enDesc: If your child is bullied, first comfort and listen carefully, and make clear it is not their fault; keep evidence and promptly ask the teacher and school to stop it and protect the child. Contact the other parents or police when needed, attend to the child s mental health and confidence, and teach proper responses rather than asking why they did not fight back.
cnDesc: 发现孩子被欺负，先安抚、认真倾听，让孩子知道不是自己的错，再保留证据、及时和老师、学校沟通，要求制止和保护；必要时联系对方家长、报警，关注孩子心理、恢复自信，教孩子正确应对，不要一味指责孩子"为什么不还手"。

cnTitle: 隔代育儿观念冲突怎么办？先感恩、再沟通、抓重点
enTitle: What to Do About Grandparent Child-Rearing Conflict: Gratitude, Communication and Priorities
enDesc: When grandparents help with a child, recognize their effort first, then gently communicate on principles (safety, health, habits) and accommodate non-essential matters. Couples should align first, affirm the grandparents and guide them with sound methods, and take on more themselves when needed without hurting feelings or giving up principles.
cnDesc: 老人帮忙带孩子，要先看到其付出和辛苦，再就原则性问题（安全、健康、习惯）温和沟通、讲道理，非原则小事适当包容；夫妻先统一口径，多肯定老人、用科学的方式引导，必要时自己承担更多，不伤和气也不放弃原则。

cnTitle: 孩子写作业拖拉怎么办？拆任务、给环境、少催促
enTitle: What to Do About Homework Procrastination: Break Tasks, Set the Environment and Less Nagging
enDesc: Homework procrastination may come from difficulty, poor planning, attention or resistance. Help break tasks into small pieces, set a fixed time and quiet environment, reduce distractions, and use agreements and encouragement instead of nagging; let the child face natural results, protect interest, and watch attention if it is severe long term.
cnDesc: 作业拖拉可能是任务太难、不会安排、注意力问题或反抗；先帮孩子把任务拆成小块、固定时间和安静环境，减少干扰，用约定和鼓励代替反复催促；让孩子承担自然结果，保护兴趣，长期严重可关注注意力问题。

cnTitle: 读公立、私立还是国际学校？结合家庭和孩子
enTitle: Public, Private or International: Fit the Family and Child
enDesc: Choose a school by family finances, educational philosophy, the child s personality and future plans (domestic or abroad), rather than assuming expensive is better. Visit and learn the teaching, curriculum, atmosphere and outcomes, afford it sustainably, and weigh the child s fit; the best school is the one that suits the child.
cnDesc: 选择学校要结合家庭经济、教育理念、孩子性格和未来规划（国内升学还是出国），不盲目追求"贵的就是好"；实地了解学校的师资、课程、氛围和升学，量力而行，兼顾孩子的适应和家庭的可持续，适合孩子的才是最好的。

cnTitle: 父母偏心、重男轻女怎么办？先照顾好自己，再划界限
enTitle: What to Do About Parental Favoritism: Care for Yourself and Set Boundaries
enDesc: With parental favoritism, acknowledge the real hurt and do not force yourself to change them. Return focus to your own growth and life, learn to refuse unreasonable demands, share care fairly, keep distance to protect yourself when needed, and build your own support system.
cnDesc: 面对父母偏心，先承认这会带来真实的委屈，不必强求改变他们；把注意力放回自己的成长和生活，对不合理的索取学会拒绝，在赡养等问题上公平分担，必要时保持距离保护自己，建立属于自己的支持系统。

cnTitle: 随份子、人情往来怎么把握？量力而行、分清关系
enTitle: How to Handle Gift Money: Afford It and Rank Relationships
enDesc: For gift money, live within your means and do not overgive for face; give a reasonable amount by relationship closeness and local customs, and budget in advance. You can decline exploitative banquets, and true friendship does not depend on the gift amount; be honest when needed.
cnDesc: 人情随份子要量力而行，不因攀比或面子打肿脸，按关系远近和当地习俗给合理金额，提前做好预算；对变味的"敛财式"宴请可以婉拒，真正的情谊不靠份子多少维系，必要时坦诚说明。

cnTitle: 兄弟姐妹分家产、赡养闹矛盾怎么办？先协商、讲依据
enTitle: How to Handle Inheritance and Care Disputes: Negotiate and Use Evidence
enDesc: For inheritance and care, first respect the parents wishes and follow a will under the law, and have siblings negotiate fairly by contribution and circumstances, keeping property and contribution records. If negotiation fails, seek mediation or statutory inheritance, and consult a lawyer when needed; do not let money destroy family bonds.
cnDesc: 分家产和赡养最好先尊重父母意愿、有遗嘱依法办理，兄弟姐妹之间坐下来协商，按贡献和实际情况公平处理，留好财产和出资凭证；协商不成可申请调解或依法继承，必要时咨询专业律师，别让钱财伤了亲情。

cnTitle: 直播带货冲动消费怎么办？先冷静、设预算、会退货
enTitle: What to Do About Livestream Impulse Buying: Cool Down, Set a Budget and Return
enDesc: Livestream sales use atmosphere and limited offers to drive impulse buying; set a cooling-off period and a budget, and ask whether you truly need it before ordering. For purchases, return them under platform rules and the seven-day no-reason right where applicable, keep orders and records, and complain about false advertising or fakes.
cnDesc: 直播带货容易被氛围和限时优惠带动而冲动下单，先给自己设冷静期和购物预算，下单前想清楚是否真的需要；已经买了的，按平台规则和"七天无理由"等正当权益退货，保留订单和聊天记录，遇到虚假宣传或假货可投诉维权。

cnTitle: 租房遇到黑中介怎么办？查资质、看合同、留证据
enTitle: What to Do About a Bad Rental Agent: Check Credentials, Read the Contract and Keep Evidence
enDesc: When renting, verify the agent s credentials and the listing, sign a proper written contract, and clarify rent, deposit, fees, repairs and termination; watch for fake listings, hidden fees and withheld deposits. Pay through proper channels and keep documents, and complain to regulators or police for fraud, protecting your rights by contract and evidence.
cnDesc: 租房要先核实中介资质和房源真实性，签正规书面合同，明确租金、押金、中介费、维修和退租条款，警惕虚假房源、乱收费和押金不退；所有费用走正规渠道并留凭证，遇到欺诈可向监管部门投诉或报警，以合同和证据维护权益。

cnTitle: 离婚财产、孩子怎么分？先了解规则、协商
enTitle: How Property and Children Are Handled: Know the Rules and Negotiate
enDesc: Divorce involves dividing joint property, debt, child custody and visitation; in principle joint property is divided under the law and children are arranged in their best interests. Try to negotiate first, understand the property and evidence, and consult a lawyer when needed through agreement or litigation, while protecting the child and not drawing them into conflict.
cnDesc: 离婚涉及共同财产分割、债务、子女抚养和探望，原则上共同财产依法分割、子女按有利于其成长安排；先尽量协商，了解共同财产范围和证据，必要时咨询专业律师，通过协议或诉讼解决，过程中保护孩子、不让其卷入矛盾。

cnTitle: 加班费、调休纠纷怎么办？先留证据、再维权
enTitle: What to Do About Overtime Disputes: Keep Evidence, Then Assert Rights
enDesc: To claim overtime pay or comp time, keep attendance, overtime records, pay slips and work schedules, and negotiate with the company. If it fails, complain to labor inspectors or file for labor arbitration, asserting rights within the time limit, and seek legal aid or a lawyer when needed; do not sign unfavorable agreements.
cnDesc: 主张加班费和调休，要先保存考勤、加班记录、工资条和工作安排等证据，与公司沟通协商；协商不成可向劳动监察部门投诉或申请劳动仲裁，依法主张，注意时效，必要时咨询法律援助或律师，不签不利的协议。

cnTitle: 电动自行车怎么安全用、上牌、充电？守规则
enTitle: How to Use Electric Bikes Safely: Registration and Charging Rules
enDesc: For electric bikes, register as required, wear a helmet, and do not carry passengers or modify illegally; buy qualified products. Charge batteries in a ventilated, supervised safe place, not indoors, in corridors or with improvised wires, and avoid overcharging to prevent fire; obey traffic rules and watch battery and wiring safety.
cnDesc: 电动自行车要依法上牌、佩戴头盔、不违规载人或改装，购买合格产品，电池充电要在通风、有人看管的安全场所，不在室内、楼道或飞线充电，避免过充，防止火灾；遵守交通规则，注意电池和线路安全。

cnTitle: 网贷、信用卡逾期怎么办？先理清、停止以贷养贷
enTitle: What to Do About Overdue Debt: Clarify and Stop Borrowing to Repay
enDesc: After overdue, stop borrowing to repay, and clarify all debts, interest and contracts; proactively negotiate with the platform or bank and explain your hardship for a reasonable plan. Live within your means and increase income, watch for anti-collection or rights-agency scams, and complain or call police for usury or abusive collection, seeking proper legal aid when needed.
cnDesc: 逾期后先停止以贷养贷，理清所有欠款、利率和合同，主动与平台或银行协商还款、说明困难，争取合理的还款方案；量入为出、增加收入，警惕打着"反催收"或"代理维权"的二次诈骗，涉及高利贷、暴力催收可投诉或报警，必要时寻求正规法律援助。

cnTitle: 遗产怎么继承、过户？先理清财产和继承人
enTitle: How to Handle Inheritance: Clarify Property and Heirs
enDesc: For inheritance, first clarify the estate, whether there is a will, and the order and shares of legal heirs, and prepare the death certificate and kinship documents. Heirs who agree can use notarization or transfer directly at property and banking institutions; disputes can use mediation or litigation, and a lawyer should be consulted when needed.
cnDesc: 办理继承先要理清遗产范围、有无遗嘱，以及法定继承人的顺序和份额，准备好死亡证明、亲属关系等材料；继承人之间协商一致可办理公证或直接到不动产、银行等机构办理过户，有争议可调解或诉讼，必要时咨询专业律师。
